purpose: Measures actual model-bead clearance at the C14 trunk proximity flags.
scope: Each road uses its commanded Z, feature-specific height and full width. XY capsules and flat bead Z intervals conservatively bound the extrusion; this does not measure physical ooze.
rounded_bead_model: A horizontal flat core of width minus height, rounded by a sphere of radius half the bead height; this conservatively caps the road ends.
